recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source follow-up is needed; any concern about the retired DSTU1 CCDA smoking-status page would belong to archived publication history rather than the current specification build.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core change request asking profile-bound value set pages to point back to their profiles instead of saying the codes were not currently used.
initial_application: Applied in svn revision 3264, represented by git commit 32310b2473ccbc1e12d708531eade7f23caee05e, which changed the old publisher PageProcessor to use singular value set usage wording and scan profile structure element bindings.
additional_context: The current core source no longer contains the old Java PageProcessor or the old observation-ccdasmokingstatus artifact. source/fhir.ini still lists Observation as an active resource, but the old CDA and US Core profile entries are commented out; source searches found none of the old smoking-status artifact names or stale unused-codes text. The Jira URL now returns 404 on build.fhir.org, while current ValueSet pages still render generated usage lists. Confluence and Zulip searches found no directly relevant later decision changing this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was made because there is no current-build authoritative source location still exhibiting the reported DSTU1 profile ValueSet usage problem.
